location.description: Location to search in (e.g., 'New York, NY', 'London, UK'). Required for 'search' mode.
location.title: Location

maxResults.description: Maximum number of business results to scrape. Only used in 'search' mode.
maxResults.title: Maximum Results

maxReviews.description: Maximum number of reviews to scrape. Only used in 'reviews' mode.
maxReviews.title: Maximum Reviews

mode.description: Choose the scraping mode: search for businesses, get full details for one place, or scrape reviews from a specific place.
mode.title: Scraping Mode

placeId.description: Canonical Google Place ID beginning with ChIJ. Use instead of placeUrl in 'details' and 'reviews' modes.
placeId.title: Google Place ID

placeUrl.description: Google Maps place URL. Required for 'details' and 'reviews' modes unless placeId is provided.
placeUrl.title: Place URL

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy. Runs start direct and fall back to the automatic Apify proxy pool only after a real block.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Leave empty for the automatic direct-to-proxy fallback.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

searchQuery.description: What to search for (e.g., 'restaurant', 'hotel', 'coffee shop'). Required for 'search' mode.
searchQuery.title: Search Query
